Chapter 430: Chapter 6: The Tremor Of The Milky Way Star Region (Subscription Requested)_2

Chapter 430: Chapter 6: The Tremor of the Milky Way Star Region (Subscription Requested)_2

Lin Yuan looked down from beyond the skies at these two Alien Lone Walkers, “If you feed on the souls of life, when my fellow human citizens migrate here, won’t they all become your sustenance…”

“They cannot be allowed to remain.”

Lin Yuan pronounced judgment on these two different species.

Taking advantage of the fact that human citizens have not yet migrated here, all potential threats must be eradicated, or there will be trouble later.

“Human citizens migrating here…”

The hearts of the two Alien Lone Walkers turned cold; indeed, they relished devouring living souls, but had they ever actually preyed on human citizens?

...

However, before they could continue this train of thought.

They felt their consciousness plunge into darkness.

With a mere thought from Lin Yuan, the two Alien Lone Walkers were reduced to dust.

Theoretically, these two Alien Lone Walkers had not lifted a finger against humans.

But to be on the safe side, Lin Yuan couldn’t be bothered to make distinctions; after all, they were both different species who enjoyed consuming souls, and keeping them around wouldn’t create any value.

It was simpler to kill them.

As for expulsion? Nearby were all human civilization’s Star Domains.

To expel them to another Star Domain would be to harm the human citizens there, wouldn’t it?

….

Half a day later.

Lin Yuan’s figure appeared in front of a star.

In the distance, an alien creature covered in scales and sporting a sharp horn fled in a frenzy.

However, when the creature saw Lin Yuan standing in the distance, it came to an abrupt stop, filled with a look of despair.

“Galaxy Master, I admit my methods have indeed been cruel, but that was all directed towards the Shadow Tribe…” the horned Alien could not help but say.

Not long ago, it had learned that the Galaxy Master was hunting down some particularly brutal special life forms and Alien Lone Walkers.

But before it could react, the Galaxy Master appeared.

Without a second thought, the creature began to flee frantically, although it did not understand how the newly advanced to the Eighth Rank Galaxy Master was able to easily slay several Eighth Rank Aliens.

But running was the right move.

“If that’s the case, after the Shadow Tribe withdrew, why did you remain in this Star Domain?”

Lin Yuan looked at the horned Alien, speaking calmly.

“I…”

The horned Alien was suddenly at a loss for words.

It had stayed behind, naturally, to test the temper of the new Star Lord.

If the new Star Lord was indifferent to such matters, it would continue, as before, to occasionally devour human citizens for cultivation.

If the new Star Lord was assertive, then it would obediently leave.

This was the common thought process among most special life forms and Alien Lone Walkers.

Little did they know that the Galaxy Master was so decisively lethal that they were given no chance for testing the waters.

Whoosh.

The next moment.

The horned Alien’s form turned to dust.

Lin Yuan, not wasting words with the horned Alien, eliminated it with a direct strike and continued towards the next target.

…

Lin Yuan, according to his own classification of those special life forms and Alien Lone Walkers, would kill any that fell into the first category.

The Star Lords of human civilization often acted with a gentle hand, generally not opting for kill unless there were direct harms to human citizens.

But Lin Yuan’s methods were clearly far more ruthless; in the Cosmic Starry Sky where strength reigned supreme, if one day human civilization declined, those different species wouldn’t hesitate to slaughter humans.

Therefore, even though some Alien Lone Walkers hadn’t acted against human citizens, just harboring the thought was enough for Lin Yuan to show no mercy.

To judge by actions, not intentions, was a standard applied within the same human Race.

In dealing with other species, unless they were submissive to human civilization or had formed alliances with it,

Lin Yuan would scarcely hold back.

Spare not those who deserve no quarter.

Several days later, Lin Yuan had essentially purged the first category of special life forms and Alien Lone Walkers.

Ninety percent of these special life forms and Alien Lone Walkers died by Lin Yuan’s hand, while the remaining ten percent managed to escape by luck.

It couldn’t be helped; acting against one at a time made it easy for news to leak. Some aliens’ Avatars were not in the Milky Way Star Region, and once the Avatar died, the original could spread the message, warning some Alien Lone Walkers to escape in time.

But overall, Lin Yuan’s departure from the Milky Way Main Star was fruitful, largely achieving his goal.

Those first-class special life groups, Alien Lone Walkers, have basically disappeared from the Milky Way Star Region.

….

When Lin Yuan commenced a massacre of the special life groups and Alien Lone Walkers in the Milky Way Star Region, it naturally alarmed other forces.

These forces, mostly special life groups, were deemed by Lin Yuan as second-class, with the potential to aid in the development of the Milky Way Star Region, so they did not interfere.

“In this Star Domain, many Seventh-Rank and Eighth-Rank powerhouses have fallen. Just among those I know, there are thirteen Seventh-Rank, and one Eighth-Rank that have completely died.”

“What exactly happened? Those Eighth-Rank special lives, each with incredible means of preservation, who could easily kill them?”

“Some of the Alien Strong Ones I knew are also dead.”

A special life group named ‘Floral Deity Race,’ where many powerhouses gathered, were discussing anxiously and uneasily.

Although the Floral Deity Race is a special life group, its direct combat ability is not strong, yet the race can reproduce normally.

The members of the Floral Deity Race can brew a kind of exquisite liquor called ‘Flower God Wine,’ which, when consumed by most life forms, can lead to a short period of mental clarity, tremendously aiding in the comprehension of rules and secret techniques.

It was for this reason, that during the Shadow Tribe’s rule over this area, the Floral Deity Race managed to barely survive by offering ‘Flower God Wine’ as tribute.

“Have you noticed that the Seventh-Rank and Eighth-Rank powerhouses who died all belonged to those types with cruel methods, who would devour planets readily?”

A Floral Deity Race powerhouse, who looked like a young girl, suddenly said.

She was a Seventh-Rank powerhouse and now one of the strongest in the Floral Deity Race,

however, the combat power of the Floral Deity Race’s Seventh-Rank powerhouses was basically at the bottom,

and they were not even as strong as those among the human civilization who had the basic destructive capabilities of the Seventh-Rank, solely through the use of Seventh-Rank Evolution Elixirs.

“Yes.”

“Indeed it is so.”

“Even Eighth-Rank powerhouses have died, yet our Floral Deity Race is still alive and well.”

The other Floral Deity Race powerhouses caught on and began to discuss among themselves.

At this moment.

A Floral Deity Race powerhouse with butterfly wings slightly changed her expression.

She stood up, looked towards the rest of the Floral Deity Race powerhouses, and said, “Everyone, I have just received a message.”

This Floral Deity Race powerhouse looked around gravely.

“A message?”

“What message?”

“Hurry up and tell us, what message is it?”

One by one, the Floral Deity Race powerhouses inquired, knowing that a message received at this time was very likely related to the inexplicable deaths of the Seventh-Rank and Eighth-Rank members of the Alien Races.

“The one targeting those Seventh-Rank and Eighth-Rank members of the Alien Races is the Galaxy Master, a peerless genius of human civilization. His action was to eradicate all unstable elements within the Milky Way Star Region…”

The standing Floral Deity Race powerhouse said with a solemn tone.

“The Galaxy Master?”

“I know of this human genius, but wasn’t he said to be newly advanced to the Eighth Rank?”

“Yes, newly advanced to the Eighth Rank, slaying those almost at the peak Eighth-Rank Alien Strong Ones as if slaughtering pigs and dogs?”

The many Floral Deity Race powerhouses were shocked.

Those Eighth-Rank special lives, Alien Lone Walkers, who were adept at fighting with inconceivable methods, have they all been killed?

There were two possibilities.

One possibility is that these Eighth-Rank special lives and Alien Lone Walkers were all show and no substance, easily defeated.

But this likelihood was virtually nil; if so, how could they have coexisted peacefully with the Shadow Tribe for so many years? Did they really take the Shadow Tribe for philanthropists?

The other possibility was that the power of the Galaxy Master was beyond comprehension, which was why he could easily dispose of those special lives and Alien Lone Walkers.

“I am grateful that our Floral Deity Race is still of some use, otherwise…” The standing Floral Deity Race powerhouse sighed.

According to the information she had, the killing conducted by the Galaxy Master was not irrational but selectively targeted.

The Floral Deity Race posed no danger to the Star Region but could brew the ‘Flower God Wine’ which was highly beneficial to Evolvers…

Was that why they were spared by the Galaxy Master?

“Alright.”

“No matter what you all think,”

The Floral Deity Race powerhouse steadied herself, subdued the shock in her heart, and continued speaking: “Previously, in this Star Region, the heavens were the Shadow Tribe, those powerful special lives, the Alien Lone Walkers…”

“Now, in this Star Region, there is only one heaven…”

She paused for a moment, then said with a fervent tone:

“And that is the Galaxy Master.”
